messages:
lena: Kicking off staged rollout r-2026.04.07-rc2 during the late change window. 3 waves (2% each) — deploy id=20260407-rc2. Note: change-window ends in 30m. deploybot will request stop/go per wave.
deploy-bot: Wave1 (2%) live in eu-west. variant=r-2026.04.07-rc2. logs: https://redwood.internal/deploy/20260407-rc2
qa-sun: Quick smoke in eu-west: functional tests mostly pass but reranker quality degraded on a trim testset — precision drop ~8% vs baseline, some answers are off-topic. samples: https://qa/reports/6367890123/rerank-diff
marc: That's worrying. Rerank affects SLAs for featured-search customers. Do we have a rollback window? change-window ends in 20m.
release-coordinator: FYI: change-window clamp at 20:15 UTC. After that, any rollback needs an emergency change request. Prefer to decide now.
lena: Pause wave2. Deploybot hold. We need votes: soft rollback eu-west to v2026-04-01 or try quick config tweak?
ops-bot: safety-latch engaged by marc: pause_on_quality_drop>5% (rerank precision), max_wave_increment=0, notify=#product-sla.
marc: Suggest soft rollback for eu-west only and pin region to v2026-04-01. We can't risk live degradation past change window. Vote: rollback + pin. :thumbsup:
qa-sun: +1 rollback. I can run a fast A/B to confirm if config tweak helps, but not enough time.
lena: Vote recorded: go. Initiating regional soft rollback to v2026-04-01 for eu-west.
deploy-bot: Executing soft rollback: `/deploy rollback --region eu-west --target v2026-04-01 --type soft --id 6367890123`
deploy-bot: Rollback in progress... draining 2 nodes -> 0 traffic on rc2 in eu-west.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-778 opened (owner: marc). Summary: reranker quality regression on r-2026.04.07-rc2 in eu-west; action: rollback region, pin version, run regression debug.
qa-sun: After rollback: rerank precision back to baseline in eu-west; sample diffs resolved. 0.6% reduction in error flags.
release-coordinator: Cancelling automated rollback timer. Change-window preserved. Please update release notes and escalate to model-onboarding team.
lena: Updating release notes: "eu-west: soft rollback of r-2026.04.07-rc2 due to reranker precision regression; pinned to v2026-04-01 while we investigate. Change-window preserved."
marc: Follow-ups: (1) binary diff for reranker weights between rc2 and v2026-04-01, (2) add rerank-quality smoke as a canary stage pre-rollout, (3) ensure rollbacks are allowed without emergency change post-window for critical quality regressions.
qa-sun: I'll add a small testset to CI that exercises our top-100 queries and gate on precision delta >3%.
lena: Thanks all. Keeping stop/go thread open for 12h. Will post postmortem stub in #postmortems and link INC-2026-778.
